# origincloud_network_acl_associations (Data Source)

Lists a subnet's ACL associations: none or one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose acl associations to list.
- `subnet` (String) The subnet whose acl associations to list.
- `zone` (String) The zone whose acl associations to list.

### Read-Only

- `acl_associations` (Attributes List) The acl associations listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acl_associations))

<a id="nestedatt--acl_associations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `acl_associations`

Read-Only:

- `acl` (String) The ACL that filters the subnet's traffic, in the subnet's VPC.
- `name` (String) The association's resource name. Its last segment is the ACL's id.
